description: S457 review (PA ruling (a)): a component prop spelled `onClick` written onto an expanded root in `lift` / `<each>` is wired as a `click` listener — never written as handler text; a URL prop (`href`) is written through the runtime guard; a non-sink prop (`title`) is written as before.
rationale: §5.2 rule 2 (S457) event-handler text from data: "In `<each>` rows and `lift` markup every attribute rule 1's name test makes an event handler (any case, `on:x` included) is wired as a listener for the lowercased event name, a component prop written onto an expanded root included"; rule 3 guards the URL write. Before: `setAttribute("onClick", it.code)` — Chromium ran it on click.
